split.method: Stratified on the joint CAD/LAD/LCX/RCA label pattern (rare patterns merged)

protocol.selection: Nested CV ROC-AUC; ties within 0.01 go to the simpler family
protocol.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on 5x repeated 5-fold out-of-fold scores of the dev set
protocol.threshold: Youden J on calibrated out-of-fold probabilities (dev set)
protocol.holdout: Single evaluation on the untouched 20% hold-out; 2000-sample bootstrap 95% CIs

prevalence.label: Prevalence (always predicts the dev-set base rate)

risk_factors_lr.label: Logistic regression on pre-test risk factors only
